question_en: How did AAPL's Greater China net sales in the June 2024 quarter (Q3 FY2024) compare with the June 2022 quarter (Q3 FY2022)?
question_vi: Doanh thu thuần khu vực Đại Trung Hoa (Greater China) của AAPL trong quý kết thúc tháng 6/2024 (Q3 FY2024) so với quý kết thúc tháng 6/2022 (Q3 FY2022) thế nào?
reference_answer: Apple's Greater China net sales were $14,604 million for the three months ended June 25, 2022 (Q3 FY2022) and $14,728 million for the three months ended June 29, 2024 (Q3 FY2024), a slight increase.

question_en: What hit to fair value did MSFT estimate from a 100 basis point rise in U.S. Treasury rates as of September 30, 2024 (Q1 FY2025)?
question_vi: MSFT ước tính giá trị hợp lý sẽ giảm bao nhiêu nếu lãi suất trái phiếu Kho bạc Mỹ tăng 100 điểm cơ bản, tính tại ngày 30/9/2024 (Q1 FY2025)?
reference_answer: As of September 30, 2024, Microsoft estimated a potential fair value loss of $1,287 million from a 100 basis point increase in U.S. treasury interest rates.
evidence_quotes: Interest rate | 100 basis point increase in U.S. treasury interest rates | (1,287) | Fair Value

question_en: How much did Amazon spend on fulfillment in the September 2022 quarter versus the September 2020 quarter?
question_vi: Amazon đã chi bao nhiêu cho hoạt động fulfillment (xử lý và giao đơn hàng) trong quý kết thúc tháng 9/2022 so với quý kết thúc tháng 9/2020?
reference_answer: Amazon's fulfillment expense was $14,705 million in the three months ended September 30, 2020 and $20,583 million in the three months ended September 30, 2022.

question_en: How many shareholder votes were cast against L. John Doerr's re-election to Google's board at the 2026 annual meeting?

reference_answer: At Alphabet's 2026 Annual Meeting, 1,001,798,113 votes were cast against L. John Doerr (with 11,355,761,435 for).

question_en: What goodwill did GOOGL carry on its balance sheet at September 30, 2022, compared with September 30, 2021?

reference_answer: Alphabet's goodwill was $22,623 million as of September 30, 2021 and $28,834 million as of September 30, 2022.

question_en: Which rival business models does MSFT list as competitive risks in its 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022 (Q3 FY2022)?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý kết thúc 31/3/2022 (Q3 FY2022), MSFT liệt kê những mô hình kinh doanh cạnh tranh nào là rủi ro?
reference_answer: Microsoft lists three: the license-based proprietary software model, which many competitors also use; competitors offering free applications, online services and content funded by third-party advertising; and companies that modify and distribute open source software at little or no cost, earning revenue on advertising or integrated products and services.
evidence_quotes: Many of our competitors also develop and sell software to businesses and consumers under this model.
Other competitors develop and offer free applications, online services and content, and make money by selling third-party advertising.
Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users, and earning revenue on advertising or integrated products and services.

question_en: How much space does Microsoft own at its Redmond headquarters campus, according to its fiscal 2026 annual report?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo thường niên năm tài chính 2026, Microsoft sở hữu bao nhiêu diện tích tại khu trụ sở chính ở Redmond?
reference_answer: Microsoft owns approximately 12 million square feet of space on approximately 520 acres of land at its Redmond headquarters, plus about 2 million square feet it leases in King County.
evidence_quotes: These facilities include approximately 12 million square feet of owned space situated on approximately 520 acres of land we own at our corporate headquarters, and approximately 2 million square feet of space we lease.

question_en: What base salary did AAPL give new CFO Kevan Parekh, per its 8-K filed in January 2025?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo 8-K nộp tháng 1/2025, AAPL trả lương cơ bản bao nhiêu cho tân giám đốc tài chính Kevan Parekh?
reference_answer: Apple raised Kevan Parekh's annual salary to $1 million effective January 1, 2025, with a cash incentive target of 175% of base salary for fiscal 2025.

question_en: In its Q1 2026 10-Q, what does Amazon say about regulators targeting so-called online gatekeepers, and how does that affect it?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 1/2026, Amazon nói gì về việc cơ quan quản lý nhắm vào các "gatekeeper" trực tuyến, và điều đó ảnh hưởng đến công ty ra sao?
reference_answer: Amazon says regulators and lawmakers are increasingly trying to control more aspects of tech companies they call online "gatekeepers", using existing laws and new ones, which raises its compliance costs and limits how it can operate its business.
evidence_quotes: regulators and lawmakers are increasingly focused on controlling additional aspects of the operations of technology companies and companies they have characterized to be online “gatekeepers”
which increases our compliance costs and limits the operation of our business

question_en: How did the district court rule on Epic's antitrust claims against AAPL, as described in the 10-Q for Q1 FY2023?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo 10-Q quý 1 năm tài chính 2023 của AAPL, tòa án quận đã phán quyết thế nào về các cáo buộc chống độc quyền của Epic?
reference_answer: On September 10, 2021, the Northern California District Court ruled for Apple on nine of the ten counts in Epic's claim and on Apple's breach of contract counterclaim, but found certain App Store Review Guidelines provisions violate California's unfair competition law and issued an injunction.
evidence_quotes: On September 10, 2021, the Northern California District Court ruled in favor of the Company with respect to nine out of the ten counts included in Epic’s claim, and in favor of the Company with respect to the Company’s claims for breach of contract.
The Northern California District Court found that certain provisions of the Company’s App Store Review Guidelines violate California’s unfair competition law and issued an injunction.
